topic_summary: A narrative in which a formal adjudicative institution (the Guild/tribunal system) requires testimony to be rendered in a legible, codified register in order to count as evidence, while the actual causal knowledge that saved a life was acquired and exercised through an uncodifiable somatic sense ('reading the grain') that the institution structurally cannot admit. The original protective lie — a Warden sacrificing one man's standing to preserve the crew's and her own — persists eleven years later as a maintained fiction that now costs the truth-tellers (a rescued child grown into the very magistrate who must rule on the case, a crew whose synchronized testimony is fraying) to keep sealed.

key_entities: Mereth Cail (Warden, author of the original report, sustains the fiction from inside the institution)
Ossin Thray (unlicensed diver, permanently exiled from institutional legibility, bearer of the sacrificed truth)
Torvel Ashe (rescued child grown into magistrate, denies conscious memory to preserve institutional neutrality, structurally indebted)
the Halcyon crew (Pell, Sorha, Buin, Katt — collective witnesses whose rehearsed testimony is showing strain)
Warden Prace (antagonist exploiting the tribunal's evidentiary rules rather than the underlying facts)
the Guild/Charter (the institution whose clauses define what counts as knowledge)
the grain/current-sense (the tacit, embodied, unlicensable form of knowing that Ossin and Mereth share)
key_tensions: Codified evidentiary legitimacy (Guild-tongue, Charter clauses, licensure) vs. embodied tacit knowledge (marsh-cant, 'reading the grain') that cannot be entered into the record
Institutional stability purchased through a maintained fiction vs. the accumulating cost of maintaining that fiction on those who must keep performing it
Individual conscience/debt vs. structural role — Torvel's personal knowledge of his own rescue cannot be voiced without destroying the office he now occupies

axes.structural_delta: The institution's evidentiary rules are constructed such that the actual causal knowledge (tacit, somatic, unlicensed) that produced the correct outcome is categorically barred from being entered as evidence, regardless of its truth-value — the exclusion is procedural, not evaluative
axes.primary_observable: Presence of a categorical admissibility rule (e.g., 'unlicensed testimony is inherently compromised hearsay') that bars a class of witness independent of the content of their testimony
axes.selection_reason: Upstream structural condition that makes the protective lie necessary in the first place; distinct observable (rule-structure) from the fiction's maintenance cost

axes.human_readable: Sacrificial Fiction Redistributing a Single Cost Across Multiple Bearers Over Time
axes.structural_delta: A single act of falsified testimony, framed at the time as minimizing total institutional damage, does not resolve but instead converts into a standing liability that redistributes itself onto new bearers (the exiled diver's foreclosed life, the rescued child's forced amnesia now that he adjudicates, the crew's rehearsed unanimity) as time passes and the original beneficiaries age into new institutional positions
axes.primary_observable: Multiple parties independently maintaining consistent, non-conflicting cover accounts of the same event across an eleven-year gap, each bearing a distinct and escalating cost to do so (revoked license, denied memory, fraying crew testimony)
axes.selection_reason: Highest centrality; the tangled_rope structural core of the narrative — the fiction that was 'cheap' at the point of origin and compounds in cost over time

axes.human_readable: Coordinated Cover Testimony Eroding Through Individual Micro-Fractures Under Renewed Institutional Pressure
axes.structural_delta: A group's rehearsed, consistent account — stable for years absent scrutiny — begins to show involuntary, individually-located signs of strain (a closed fist, a held-too-long pause, an avoidance of eye contact) the moment the account is re-tested under formal pressure, and these signs are legible only to those with prior embodied familiarity with the tellers, not to the formal adjudicators whose only tools are the codified record
axes.primary_observable: Divergence between what the formal record captures (uniform verbal testimony, no procedural flag) and what an embodied observer (Mereth, Torvel) detects (bodily tells: fist, pause, gaze-avoidance) in the same witnesses at the same moment
axes.selection_reason: Distinct observable (interpersonal micro-signal vs. institutional rule vs. long-horizon liability accrual); captures the narrative's present-tense mechanism of collapse rather than its origin or its long-term cost structure

axes.human_readable: Denial of Personal Stake as Precondition for Holding Adjudicative Authority
axes.structural_delta: An adjudicator with direct, undeniable personal history in the matter before him can only continue to occupy the adjudicative role by formally asserting a lack of memory/stake that he privately knows to be false, making the legitimacy of his office contingent on a performed rather than actual absence of interest
axes.primary_observable: Formal recusal motion raised and denied on the stated grounds of no memory/no disqualifying interest, contradicted by private, embodied evidence (eye contact retained in memory) that the adjudicator does not disclose
axes.selection_reason: Deferred: a specific instantiation of the distributed-liability axis rather than an independently distinct structural delta; largely absorbed by protective_fiction_as_distributed_liability's victim set

axes.human_readable: Relational Bond Persisting Precisely Where Institutional Instruments Cannot Reach
axes.structural_delta: Two parties retain a form of mutual trust and coordinated competence that predates and exceeds any institutional sanction, and this bond's value is constituted specifically by its immunity to institutional ruling — it is valuable because no tribunal can grant, revoke, or adjudicate it
axes.primary_observable: Coordinated wordless action (diving together without depth-calls, license checks, or Guild flag) producing successful outcomes through a shared tacit register absent any institutional mediation
axes.selection_reason: Deferred: thematically resonant closing image but structurally a restatement/mirror of epistemic_inadmissibility_of_tacit_expertise from the beneficiary side rather than an independent axis; risk of Type A overlap

deferred_axes.structural_delta: Adjudicative legitimacy contingent on performed rather than actual absence of personal stake
deferred_axes.deferral_reason: Substantially absorbed by protective_fiction_as_distributed_liability's victim set; not independently distinct under §3 pairwise test

deferred_axes.structural_delta: A trust bond whose value derives from its immunity to institutional ruling
deferred_axes.deferral_reason: Mirrors epistemic_inadmissibility_of_tacit_expertise from the beneficiary side; Type A overlap risk, same underlying observable (tacit coordination outside codified channels)

omegas.description: Is Mereth's original false report best read as a mountain-adjacent forced choice (any Warden in that institutional configuration would have had to choose similarly) or as a piton — an act that could have been otherwise and calcified only through repetition? The narrative supports both readings and does not resolve which.
omegas.source: F03 (Hasty Generalization) — protective_fiction_as_distributed_liability classified as snare assuming the choice was structurally coerced, but the text leaves room for reading it as a contingent individual act

omegas.description: The crew members (Pell, Sorha, Buin, Katt) are victims of the distributed liability but also active daily participants in maintaining it. The narrative does not clarify whether they know the report is false or merely sense that something is being protected without knowing what.
omegas.source: Dark Matter Probe 2 (Absence Inventory) — the crew's epistemic state regarding the original lie is never made explicit

omegas.description: Charter Sixth, Clause Eleven (barring diver-testimony as hearsay) is presented as fixed and unchallenged throughout. Whether this rule is a functioning-but-unexamined mountain of the setting, or a revisable piton the story simply never surfaces as revisable, remains undetermined — affects whether epistemic_inadmissibility_of_tacit_expertise should be treated as permanent setting-physics or as a contestable institutional artifact.
omegas.source: §1.3 Commitment System Recognition scan — the Charter functions as a kernel-adjacent fixed reference, but drift_status is not determinable from the text alone

fracture_scan.notes: F03 detected on protective_fiction_as_distributed_liability's hypothesis classification (snare vs. piton): the narrative does not conclusively establish whether Mereth's original falsification was institutionally coerced (snare — no viable alternative existed) or a contingent choice that then calcified through eleven years of repetition (piton). Recorded as omega_original_choice_classification rather than resolved, since the text supports both readings and forcing a single classification would overclaim textual evidence. No lens gap or trespass detected; the extraction stayed within the narrative's own institutional/epistemic register rather than importing external domain knowledge.
